messages.author: 2c7106159c8e6d5b
messages.subject: association plotting with mutliple panels
parts:
Hi,

Ideally I'd like to plot two association plots (plot_spnasso) side by side, the first showing the full support interval without a lower panel for genes, the second focusing in on a top SNP region, and including a lower panel with gene names. 

If I don't include a gene names lower panel, I can generate side-by-side plots with either par(mfrow=...) or layout(). But incorporating gene names into either plot seems to wipe out the multi-panel settings. Are there any plot settings you can think of to work around this? If not I can just put things together after the fact. 

Thanks.

David

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] association plotting with mutliple panels
parts:
The plot of snp association results with genes uses par(mfrow=...) to get the multi-panel plot.
If you want a custom multi-panel plot, you'll need to create the pieces yourself.

karl
